tagline: 尼康便携相机，1983 年发布
description: 尼康于1983年推出的便携相机。配备35mm f/2.8 with autofocus from 0.8m to infinity. It had 5 elements in 4 groups. 46mm filter thread.。感光度early version ASA/ISO 50-400; later version ASA/ISO 50-1000.。

specs.镜头: 35mm f/2.8 with autofocus from 0.8m to infinity. It had 5 elements in 4 groups. 46mm filter thread.
specs.曝光测光: Fully automatic, range EV 6 (f/2.8 at 1/8 sec.) to EV 17 (f/17.5 at 1/430 sec.) with ASA/ISO 100 film
specs.感光度: early version ASA/ISO 50-400; later version ASA/ISO 50-1000.
specs.英文简介: The L35AF was Nikon's first compact camera with autofocus.
